findings.criterion: Mark-scheme row boundaries and exact source-backed excerpts
findings.summary: Eight of 183 marking items retain the generic Question / Answer / Marks header of the following table after the current row's answer and displayed mark.
findings.impact: The marking excerpt crosses its source row boundary and associates unrelated layout text with the target. This is the same defect class corrected for 9618_w25_qp_13-q7-pe-mi-1 in v2, so the candidate does not satisfy the complete marking-row gate. A4's reported 183/183 marking-target check did not detect these instances.
findings.detection: Independent complete scan of mark_or_condition_or_null for a terminal Question, Answer, Marks header, followed by direct inspection of the cited original MS pages and candidate renders.

findings.required_fix: A2 must produce a new frozen candidate version that removes only the unrelated trailing generic headers from these eight mark_or_condition_or_null fields while preserving each answer, marking condition, displayed mark, target, locator, transcript reference and visual dependency. Refresh candidate manifests and handoff.
findings.required_retest: A4 must inspect all eight corrected records against the cited original PDF pages and rerun the complete 183-item linkage/row-boundary check on the new exact candidate. A9 must review the new frozen candidate and same-version specialist evidence before A0 decides the gate.
